hypothesis: W-R41 exposed usable pair-distinguishing information in XOR-invariant lag2 features while W-R42 single-candidate prediction stayed near chance. Training a fixed-width paired relative-order readout may exploit the difference between alternatives even though a single candidate classifier fails. This is an explicit change of task/interface, not independent single-stream cognition.
freeze: Before first use freeze new disjoint development seeds2112..2127, sealed heldout2128..2143, exact pinned W-R42 lag2 16-feature, 4-bit quantization, identity-only training, identity/XOR55 heldout, 3 generators/2 swap sites, balanced pair-order augmentation, 32 epochs, LR0.1, identical 16 coefficients + bias models. No post-result selection or label tuning.
arms: independent_perceptron: classify each positive/negative candidate separately with the exact original 1728 balanced examples, then compare its continuous scores on a test pair

paired_difference_perceptron: train relative ordering on 864 true first/second development pairs and corresponding 864 sign-reversed examples, 16 lag2 differences and 32 perceptron epochs, then select the higher-score candidate
metrics: Record matched pair preference accuracy (ties count 0.5), exact within-pair feature ties, per-seed/site/generator success-tie-failure for both arms. Preserve original true/false labelling and require XOR feature/difference equivalence. Do not report pairwise decision as standalone binary classification accuracy.
classification: PAIRED_RANK_GAIN iff paired relative model >=0.65 preference accuracy and exceeds independent score-ranking by >=0.10 with XOR55 equality; PARTIAL_GAIN iff paired advantage >=0.05; NO_GAIN otherwise. Include all failing generators.
controls: Both models observe identical development candidate sequences and exactly 1728 balanced labelled training items, 16 weights+bias, 32 epochs, LR0.1; pairwise model receives both alternatives as an additional information interface, explicitly not same inference task
All feature transforms constructed exclusively from public raw base and observed alternatives. No future ground truth in input, privileged label sent to heldout learner or sealed-fitness tuning
Identical positive/negative observed candidates necessarily force tied features; preserve these as half-correct rather than selecting by label
One original first-use evidence artifact then one full Go test/build, no accepted-ref or production authority mutation
claim_limit: Synthetic pairwise comparator with two alternatives available simultaneously, NOT improvement to single-candidate recurrent cognition or general language understanding.
